# By Hamdi

> By Hamdi is the one-person AI product studio of Hamdi Mohamud Hassan, based in Minnesota. Hamdi builds useful AI-powered products, shares the build-learn-share process publicly, and offers hands-on help to people building products with AI.

Canonical website: https://byhamdi.com

## Hamdi Mohamud Hassan

Hamdi Mohamud Hassan is the founder and builder behind By Hamdi. Public profiles may also use the names Hamdi Hassan, Hamdi Mohamud, or Hamdi.

Profiles:
- LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/in/hamdi-hassan-ai/
- GitHub: https://github.com/hamdi2008
- X: https://x.com/hamdimahmuud
- YouTube: https://www.youtube.com/@hamdimohamud08

## Vibe Coding Help Session

By Hamdi offers a 1-on-1 Vibe Coding Help Session for people who started building something with ChatGPT, Claude, or another AI tool and are stuck on what comes next.

The session is hands-on and focused on solving a specific blocker. Examples include GitHub, deployment, databases, authentication, email, payments, domains, security, onboarding, and getting an AI-built product working and live.

- Price: $99 USD
- Length: 60–90 minutes
- Service page: https://byhamdi.com/#book

## Products

### Life in Views
A personal life-planning app for organizing priorities across Today, Week, Month, Year, and Long-Term views, with measurements and recaps.
https://lifeinviews.com

### MNMuslim
A digital home for Muslims in Minnesota, including local services and events.
https://www.mnmuslim.com/

### MNHalal
A directory for finding halal restaurants, cafes, bakeries, markets, food trucks, and other halal food options in Minnesota.
https://www.mnhalal.com/

### MN Somali
A public reference site compiling reliable information and source links about Somali Minnesotans.
https://www.mnsomalis.com/
